_README: CAMA export probe work-list, ordered by parcel share (the lever on statewide depth).
cama_schema_probe.py reads this file and classifies each county's export: iasworld / other_vendor / roll_only.
candidate_url is the ACTUAL export to probe (a ZIP of CSV/DBF, an ArcGIS REST layer, or a CSV/JSON).
It is intentionally EMPTY here — populate it from the county property appraiser's public data-download page.
appraiser_hint is a RESEARCH STARTING POINT (a public domain), NOT an asserted export URL — verify it.
We do not guess the vendor from memory; the schema at pull time is the authoritative signal.
format_hint: one of 'arcgis' | 'zip' | 'csv' | 'json' | null (null = auto-detect from content).
The full 67-county work-list is seeded in public.cama_vendor_probe; start with these top-share counties.
The number that matters: if >=4 of the top 10 are iasworld, the Volusia loader takes rich coverage
from 2.86% to roughly a quarter of the state's parcels. If none are, it is per-vendor work and the plan changes.

counties.appraiser_hint: bcpa.net (verify — find the data-download / GIS export)
